vehicles.slot: Small round cap on top-left corner of shifter console — pry off to access slot
shift: Turn ignition to ON (do not start engine).
Locate the shift lock override slot — Small round cap on top-left corner of shifter console — pry off to access slot.
Insert the key (or a thin flathead) into the slot and press firmly downward.
While holding the slot, press the brake pedal.
Move the selector from Park to Neutral.
Remove key from slot and replace cap.
neutral: Apply parking brake and chock wheels.
Connect jump pack to battery — Under hood, driver side.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and shift to Neutral normally.
If power cannot be restored, use the shift lock slot above — Small round cap on top-left corner of shifter console — pry off to access slot.
vehicles.notes: Key interlock recall Service Bulletin 05-009 affects some units — verify recall was completed.
vehicles.warn: Always apply parking brake and chock wheels before releasing Park on any incline.
vehicles.towMethod: Lift from front — front (drive) wheels in the air, or flatbed. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.
towNotes: FWD: lift from front (front/drive wheels in the air) freely. If rear-lift is not possible, place wheel dollies under the REAR wheels and tow front-first.
MANUAL TRANSMISSION OPTION: If equipped with manual trans, no shift lock — depress clutch and select Neutral. No override slot needed.

vehicles.slot: Small slot near the gear selector base on the console — pry off plastic cap, insert key. DCT: RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST for reliable operation — DCT cannot shift without power.
shift: RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST — DCT requires 12V power to shift reliably.
Connect jump pack — battery under hood.
Once powered, press brake and select N.
WITHOUT POWER — shift lock slot (mechanical override only):
Locate the small plastic cap near the gear selector base on the console.
Pry off the cap with the ignition key or small flathead.
Insert key into the slot and press firmly. Press brake. Move selector to N.
NOTE: Even with mechanical override, DCT clutch packs will not disengage without power — this may not work reliably.
neutral: Apply parking brake.
DCT REQUIRES POWER: Connect jump pack to battery — Under hood.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and shift to N normally.
If mechanical slot is used without power: DCT transmissions may resist — apply steady firm pressure and hold for several seconds.
vehicles.notes: 8-speed DCT: power strongly preferred. Flatbed tow only for DCT variants.
vehicles.warn: 8-speed DCT: FLATBED ONLY. Do not tow with wheels on ground.
vehicles.towMethod: Lift from front — front (drive) wheels in the air, or flatbed. Wheel-lift max: 35 mph, 50 miles — flatbed preferred for longer distances.
towNotes: FWD: lift from front (front/drive wheels in the air) freely. If rear-lift is not possible, place wheel dollies under the REAR wheels and tow front-first.
DUAL-CLUTCH TRANSMISSION (DCT): Power is strongly preferred to shift to neutral. DCT without power may not release — use flatbed if shift override fails.

vehicles.slot: 2014-2015 (6-speed Honda AT): small cap near selector lever on console — pry off, insert key, press down. 2016-2020 (ZF 9HP push-button): NO CABIN OVERRIDE. Transmission stub on TOP of the ZF 9HP — rotate with small crescent wrench to disengage parking pawl.
shift: RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST — preferred for all variants.
Connect jump pack to battery under hood. Once powered, press brake and select N on push-button selector.
2014-2015 (6-speed Honda AT) WITHOUT POWER:
Locate the small plastic cap near the gear selector lever on the console. Pry off with key or flathead.
Insert key or flathead into the slot and press firmly downward. Hold. Press brake. Move selector to N.
2016-2020 (ZF 9HP push-button) WITHOUT POWER — ENGINE BAY PROCEDURE:
Remove the engine covers (plastic trim panels on top of engine).
Locate the stub/shaft with two flat faces on the TOP of the ZF 9HP transmission.
Grip the stub with a small crescent wrench and rotate CLOCKWISE to disengage the parking pawl.
Someone must ride the vehicle to hold it in place while it is moved — it will re-engage when released.
FLATBED with dollies is the safer practical option if power cannot be restored.
neutral: Apply parking brake.
Connect jump pack — battery under hood.
Once powered, press brake and select N on electronic selector.
ZF 9HP (2016-2020) WITHOUT POWER: engine bay procedure required — see shift steps. No cabin override.
SH-AWD: FLATBED PREFERRED.
vehicles.notes: CRITICAL: The slot is at the FRONT of the console near the dashboard, NOT at the shifter base — this is a very common mistake. Always carry a jump pack with ZF 9HP-equipped vehicles.
vehicles.warn: ZF 9HP: jump pack strongly recommended. Forcing shift without power risks transmission damage.
vehicles.towMethod: FLATBED ONLY — SH-AWD cannot be disabled. If no flatbed available, use wheel-lift with dollies on free-rolling axle.
towNotes: FULL-TIME AWD: Cannot disengage AWD. Flatbed is the safest method. If using wheel-lift, dollies MUST be used on the free-rolling axle to prevent driveline damage.

knownIssues.title: ZF 9HP Shift Lock Requires Power
knownIssues.detail: The ZF 9HP 9-speed transmission requires 12V power to shift. Without power the standard slot method is very difficult. Always carry a jump pack. A dedicated ZF 9HP override tool (~$50 online) is the most reliable mechanical option.

knownIssues.title: Shift Lock Slot Location Misidentified
knownIssues.detail: The shift lock slot is at the FRONT lip of the center console near the dashboard — NOT near the shift handle base. Technicians and operators regularly probe the wrong location. Look at where the console meets the dash.

battery.warnings: ZF 9HP: must restore power before TC shift. Use jump pack rated for AGM batteries.

vehicles.slot: NO CABIN OVERRIDE. 4th-gen MDX has no shift lock release accessible from inside. Restore 12V power to shift normally. Dead battery with no way to jump: FLATBED with dollies only.
shift: RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST — this is the only practical option.
Connect jump pack to battery under hood.
Once powered, press brake and select N on push-button selector.
WITHOUT POWER: there is NO cabin shift override on the 4th-gen MDX.
The owner's manual confirms: flatbed is required if power cannot be restored.
FLATBED with wheel dollies is the field solution.
neutral: Apply parking brake.
Connect jump pack — battery under hood.
Once powered, press brake and select N.
If power cannot be restored: FLATBED ONLY with wheel dollies.
No cabin override exists on this generation.

knownIssues.title: No Cabin Neutral Override — Flatbed Required if Power Lost
knownIssues.detail: The 4th-generation MDX (2022+) has no shift lock release accessible from the cabin. If the battery is completely dead and cannot be jumped, the vehicle cannot be shifted to neutral. Flatbed with wheel dollies is the only safe field solution.

vehicles.slot: Small cap near gear selector base on center console
shift: Turn ignition to ON (do not start engine).
Locate the shift lock override slot — Small cap near gear selector base on center console.
Pry off cap with ignition key or small flathead.
Insert key or thin flathead into the slot and press firmly downward.
While holding, press the brake pedal firmly.
Move selector from Park to Neutral.
Remove tool and replace cap.
neutral: Apply parking brake and chock wheels.
Connect jump pack to battery — under the hood.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and shift to Neutral normally.

Transfer case: shift to 2H (2WD) before road towing — manual floor lever.
vehicles.notes: Isuzu Trooper platform. Transfer case must be in 2H for road towing. Avoid towing in 4H or 4L on dry pavement.
vehicles.warn: Shift transfer case to 2H before road towing. 4WD modes will damage drivetrain on pavement.
vehicles.towMethod: 2H: lift from rear — rear (drive) wheels in the air. Transfer case to 2H first. Flatbed preferred.

positions: 2H — rear wheels only — use for road towing
4H — part-time 4WD high — do NOT tow on dry road
4L — low range — NEVER tow on road
steps: Move the transfer case FLOOR LEVER to 2H (2WD).
NEVER tow in 4H or 4L on dry pavement — driveline damage.

towNotes: Isuzu Trooper-based platform. Shift transfer case to 2H before road towing.
FLATBED preferred for this vehicle due to age and drivetrain complexity.

vehicles.slot: Electronic push-button selector — same as 3rd gen ZF 9HP. NO CABIN OVERRIDE. Restore 12V power or use engine bay transmission stub procedure.
shift: RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST.
Connect jump pack — battery under hood. Once powered, select N on push-button selector.
WITHOUT POWER: NO cabin override. See MDX 3rd Gen ZF 9HP engine bay stub procedure.
FLATBED with dollies if power cannot be restored.
neutral: Apply parking brake.
Connect jump pack to battery — under hood. Use AGM-compatible jump pack.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and select N on electronic selector.
Electronic selectors require power — mechanical override is last resort only.
SH-AWD: FLATBED PREFERRED.
vehicles.notes: 2021 MDX is the first year of the 4th Gen body but mechanically shares features with late 3rd Gen. Treat as 4th Gen.
vehicles.warn: AWD — FLATBED PREFERRED. If wheel-lift must be used, dollies required on free-rolling axle.
vehicles.towMethod: FLATBED ONLY — SH-AWD cannot be disabled. Wheel-lift with dollies on free-rolling axle if no flatbed.
towNotes: FULL-TIME AWD: Cannot disengage SH-AWD. Flatbed is safest. If using wheel-lift, dollies MUST be under the free-rolling axle.

battery.warnings: AGM battery — use AGM-compatible jump pack. SH-AWD flatbed preferred.
